# pve_pool (Data Source)

Reads a Proxmox VE resource pool from `GET /pools/{poolid}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_pool" "prod" {
  poolid = "prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `poolid` (String) The pool identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Description of the pool, empty when unset.
- `members` (Attributes List) Current pool members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Member object identifier, e.g. `qemu/100` or `storage/local`.
- `node` (String) Node hosting the member object.
- `storage` (String) Storage identifier, set only for storage members.
- `type` (String) Member type. Must be one of: `qemu`, `lxc`, `openvz`, `storage`.
- `vmid` (Number) Guest VMID, set only for guest members.
